supporting_observations.claim: Repeated authentication failures for svc-routes occurred at roughly one-minute intervals on FILE-COP-01. The failures identify FILE-COP-01 as the workstation, process ID 0x1718, and status 0xc000006a, indicating an incorrect password.
Domain-controller records also show svc-routes pre-authentication failures from 10.52.20.20 during this period.

The minute-like failure pattern from FILE-COP-01 is consistent with the supplied context that RouteSync re-authenticates every minute and that svc-routes was scheduled for password rotation at 13:30 UTC; this makes a stale job credential a plausible explanation, but does not establish that explanation.

At 13:48, explicit-credential events show PowerShell using svc-routes credentials to target FILE-COP-01 from both DC-COP-01 and WS-KNGUYEN-01. These sources differ from the supplied remote-administration practice, but the events alone do not establish whether authentication succeeded or why the credentials were used.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include process command lines, parent processes, or a mapping of the logged IP addresses to assets beyond the host and workstation fields shown.
The supplied records do not establish whether the explicit-credential attempts succeeded or whether they are causally related to the repeated failures.
The evidence provided does not include a password-change audit record or RouteSync configuration/update history.
claims_not_established: Whether the failures were caused by RouteSync continuing to use the old password after the scheduled rotation.
Whether either PowerShell explicit-credential event successfully authenticated to FILE-COP-01.
Whether the 13:48 credential use was an authorized but undocumented update attempt, an unrelated operation, or malicious activity.
Whether there was subsequent successful use of svc-routes or other activity outside the supplied records.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve the svc-routes password-change audit event and RouteSync job configuration or update history around 13:30–13:50 UTC.
Collect process command lines, parent-process details, and endpoint telemetry for PowerShell on DC-COP-01 and WS-KNGUYEN-01 at 13:48 UTC.
Correlate the explicit-credential events with successful and failed logons on FILE-COP-01 and domain-controller authentication records.
Verify whether the 13:48 activity was authorized, given the supplied practice that remote administration is performed from WS-PBECKER-01.
